summary: Russian forces launched widespread missile and drone attacks across Ukraine, causing casualties in Lozova (2 dead, 34 injured) and strikes in Dnipro, Rivne, and Lviv. Ukrainian forces conducted deep strikes, hitting a chemical plant in Perm Krai (critical for Russian explosives supply), an electronic warfare station in Bryansk, and command posts in Zaporizhzhia and Luhansk. The situation on the eastern front remains highly volatile with Russian advances near Shcherbaky, while strategic discussions focus on the potential fall of Sloviansk and Kramatorsk.
key_points: Russian missile and drone strikes hit multiple Ukrainian cities, including a deadly strike on a market in Lozova, Kharkiv region, resulting in two deaths and 34 injuries. (Source: @UkraineNow/84840, @mon1tor_ua/77483)
Ukrainian drones successfully struck the 'Azot' chemical plant in Perm Krai, Russia, which supplies 34% of explosives for the Russian military-industrial complex. (Source: @UkraineNow/84853)
Ukrainian forces launched precision strikes on an electronic warfare station in Bryansk region, Russia, and command posts in occupied Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia regions. (Source: @UkraineNow/84844)

Russian forces advanced near Mali Shcherbaky and Shcherbaky on the southern front, while Ukrainian President Zelensky warned that losing Sloviansk and Kramatorsk could open the path to Dnipro and Pavlohrad. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23924, @UkraineNow/84842)
Russia introduced a new cruise missile, 'Filin,' capable of flying at very low altitudes up to 6 km, targeting Ukrainian infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/84847)
Ukraine signed a €300 million support package with Finland and partnered with ICEYE and Nokia to establish a sovereign satellite communication network. (Source: @UkraineNow/84848, @DeepStateUA/23923)

Intense Russian drone and missile activity was reported across northern, western, and southern Ukraine, with Geran-5 missiles and Shahed drones targeting Kyiv, Lviv, Rivne, and Poltava regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77475, @mon1tor_ua/77448, @mon1tor_ua/77469)

russia: Russia launched a new cruise missile, 'Filin,' capable of low-altitude flight up to 6 km, according to Ukrainian defense intelligence. (Source: @UkraineNow/84847)

Russian forces launched strikes on Lozova, causing significant civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. (Source: @UkraineNow/84840)
northern_front: Russian reactive UAVs operated along the Belarusian border in northern Chernihiv region, heading towards Kyiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/89682, @kpszsu/89700)

southern_front: Ukrainian strike UAVs targeted Pavlohrad in Dnipropetrovsk region from the southeast. (Source: @kpszsu/89703)
Russian Shahed drones crossed from the Black Sea towards Mykolaiv region and from Kherson towards occupied Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77475, @mon1tor_ua/77448)
Ukrainian forces struck Russian command posts and UAV control points in occupied Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @UkraineNow/84844)
Russian reactive UAVs were tracked near Podilsk in Odessa region, moving towards Vinnytsia. (Source: @kpszsu/89701, @kpszsu/89737)
